title: unwrap() on SystemTime::duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH) lacks reasoning comment
description: server_stores.rs has two identical .unwrap() calls on SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH) (lines ~122 and ~195 in new_with_ipfs and new_mem_impl). This cannot fail at runtime because UNIX_EPOCH is in the past, but the unwrap is undocumented. Per project policy, every .unwrap() in production code needs a comment explaining why it cannot fail. Fix: add // UNIX_EPOCH is always <= now(); this cannot fail. or replace with .unwrap_or_default() / .expect("system clock is before 1970").
